H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H6845: to hide (by covering over); by implication, to hoard or reserve; figuratively to deny; specifically (favorably) to protect, (unfavorably) to lurk
H6256: time, especially (adverb with preposition) now, when, etc.
H3045: to know (properly, to ascertain by seeing); used in a great variety of senses, figuratively, literally, euphemistically and inferentially (including observation, care, recognition; and causatively, instruction, designation, punishment, etc.)
H2372: to gaze at; mentally to perceive, contemplate (with pleasure); specifically, to have avision of

H1497: to pluck off; specifically to flay, strip or rob
H7462: to tend a flock; i.e. pasture it; intransitively, to graze (literally or figuratively); generally to rule; by extension, to associate with (as a friend)
H2543: a male ass (from its dun red)
H5090: to drive forth (a person, an animal or chariot), i.e. lead, carry away; reflexively, to proceed (i.e. impel or guide oneself); also (from the panting induced by effort), to sigh
H2254: to wind tightly (as a rope), i.e. to bind; specifically, by a pledge; figuratively, to pervert, destroy; also to writhe in pain (especially of parturition)
H490: a widow; also a desolate place

H2964: something torn, i.e. a fragment, e.g. a fresh leaf, prey, food

H3899: food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)
H5288: (concretely) a boy (as active), from the age of infancy to adolescence; by implication, a servant; also (by interch. of sex), a girl (of similar latitude in age)

H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H2263: to clasp (the hands or in embrace)

H7699: the breast of a woman or animal (as bulging)
H1980: to walk (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively)
H5375: to lift, in a great variety of applications, literal and figurative, absolute and relative

H996: between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or

H1869: to tread; by implication, to walk; also to string abow (by treading on it in bending)

H4962: properly, an adult (as of full length); by implication, a man (only in the plural)

H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H216: illumination or (concrete) luminary (in every sense, including lightning, happiness, etc.)
H5234: properly, to scrutinize, i.e. look intently at; hence (with recognition implied), to acknowledge, be acquainted with, care for, respect, revere, or (with suspicion implied), to disregard, ignore, be strange toward, reject, resign, dissimulate (as if ignorant or disowning)
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry

H5869: an eye (literally or figuratively); by analogy, a fountain (as the eye of the landscape)
H5003: to commit adultery; figuratively, to apostatize
H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H5399: properly, a breeze, i.e. (by implication) dusk (when the evening breeze prevails)
H7789: to spy out, i.e. (generally) survey, (for evil) lurk for, (for good) care for
H5643: a cover (in a good or a bad, a literal or a figurative sense)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H2864: to force a passage, as by burglary; figuratively, with oars
H2822: the dark; hence (literally) darkness; figuratively, misery, destruction, death, ignorance, sorrow, wickedness
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H2856: to close up; especially to seal
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H1242: properly, dawn (as the break of day); generally, morning

H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H4325: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
H7043: to be (causatively, make) light, literally (swift, small, sharp, etc.) or figuratively (easy, trifling, vile, etc.)
H2513: properly, smoothness; figuratively, flattery; also an allotment
H6437: to turn; by implication, to face, i.e. appear, look, etc.
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H7585: Hades or the world of the dead (as if a subterranean retreat), including its accessories and inmates
H2398: properly, to miss; hence (figuratively and generally) to sin; by inference, to forfeit, lack, expiate, repent, (causatively) lead astray, condemn
H7911: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of, from want of memory or attention

H6086: a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks)
H6135: sterile (as if extirpated in the generative organs)

H3190: to be (causative) make well, literally (sound, beautiful) or figuratively (happy, successful, right)
H4900: to draw, used in a great variety of applications (including to sow, to sound, to prolong, to develop, to march, to remove, to delay, to be tall, etc.)
H3581: vigor, literally (force, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (capacity, means, produce); also (from its hardiness) a large lizard
H539: properly, to build up or support; to foster as a parent or nurse; figuratively to render (or be) firm or faithful, to trust or believe, to be permanent or quiet; morally to be true or certain;
H2416: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)

H4592: a little or few (often adverbial or compar.)
H4355: to tumble (in ruins); figuratively, to perish
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H7092: to draw together, i.e. close; by implication, to leap (by contracting the limbs); specifically, to die (from gathering up the feet)
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H7641: a stream (as flowing); also an ear of grain (as growing out); by analogy, a branch
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H645: strictly a demonstrative particle, here; but used of time, now or then
H4310: who? (occasionally, by a peculiar idiom, of things); also (indefinitely) whoever; often used in oblique construction with prefix or suffix
H3576: to lie (i.e. deceive), literally or figuratively
H408: not (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, nothing
H4405: a word; collectively, a discourse; figuratively, a topic
